item.title: Galway GAA launches Muintir na Gaillimhe 2026 Business Partnership Programme
item.description: Galway GAA is tapping into the city and county’s business community in an effort to maximise support the continued growth and success of Galway’s intercounty teams. Officially launching its flagship business partnership entitled Muintir na Gaillimhe, the idea is also to strengthen links between sport, business and community across the county. item.title: Judge ‘horrified’ at man walkingdown street with samurai sword
item.description: By Ronan Judge A Judge has said she was “horrified” that a man would walk down a busy street in Galway City carrying a samurai sword. item.title: Team reveals latest update on excavation at Tuam Mother and Baby Home
item.description: A further 22 sets of infant remains have been discovered as part of the ongoing excavation at the site of the former Tuam Mother and Baby Home.
